.... Opposite Party
 Mr. S. Panda, Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.41 of 2025 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C.-I (Cog.Taking), Baripada arising out of Jharpokharia P.S. Case No.101 of 2 0 2 5 , f o r c o m m i s s i o n o f o f f e n c e s p u n i s h a b l e u n d e r S e c t i o n s 120-B/201/417/419/420/467/468/470/471 of IPC read with Section 66(C)/66(D) of I.T. Act.
3. List this matter on 18.06.2025.
Learned counsel for the State is requested to obtain the Case Diary in the meanwhile.
4. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
5. It is needless to say that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency.
6. Copy of this order be made over to the learned counsel for the State enabling him to take necessary follow up action.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Ayesha Designation: Senior Stenographer
